verdict.rationale: The docs show a few narrow, feature-specific bulk actions. 'Publish draft policies' publishes all eligible drafts at once, a one-click secure baseline sets organization-wide device policy, and removing a framework cascades removal of its unused controls. The MCP server and service keys let agents and scripts act on the workspace, but nothing shows bulk operations through that interface. missing for 10: general multi-select or bulk-edit across items (e.g., findings, controls, users), documented bulk endpoints or MCP tools for AI-driven batch operations, a public API spec (OpenAPI probes 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
